quotes.text: Multi-talented Irmo Russel (born 15 March 1956 in Aruba, Caribbean Sea) joined the group in 1995, who in addition to stepping into Bannister's shoes was instrumental in revitalizing the group's creative potential, by becoming a composer, video director, and occasionally assuming the role of lead singer on some of the tracks.

McInerney kept performing as Bad Boys Blue; at first he performed solo with a live group and backing singers but in the following year he was joined by Carlos Ferreira (born 11 April 1969 in Mozambique), and this presently UK-based duo set out to work on a new album, with the French producers MS Project.
Bad Boys Blue, in May 2008, released a brand new album called Heart & Soul with 13 new original songs.
This version of the group completed recording of several brand new tracks, all penned and sung by McCoy.
Though they've maintained their sound since their formation in 1984, Bad Boys Blue always update their style accordingly to suit whatever era they find themselves in.
They incorporated rave in their '90s and 2000s releases, and EDM permeates their releases since the 2010s, but they retain techno-pop and disco as their roots.

The group's vast catalog traces through a timeline of dance music across successive decades and portrays them as a group whose refusal to remake their 1985 breakout single "You're A Woman," with its spacious 808 sound, deems them unpredictable and keeps them modern.
